protoCognitiveBehaviors.mechanics: Feedforward regulation sensing acoustic/precursor tremors (M_2) to pre-repress catalytic intake before boiling eruption.
Contiguous 3-inverter limit cycle ring oscillator maintaining 6-state periodic pacing without external inputs.
Cross-coupled feedback retaining 1-bit memory of nutrient abundance across multi-tick famine intervals.
Contact lysis predation assimilating victim metabolic organelle cassettes into predator cytoplasm.
Direct interspecies electron transfer donating surplus battery tokens to heterospecific neighbors.
Clonal syncytium differentiating into feeding trophocytes, somatic shields, and pacemaker sensory poles.

morphologicalTopologies.description: Hexagonal basal lithotrophic or autotrophic unit in mineral pore.
Vertical hexagonal pillar extending into pelagic current for plume interception.
Branching syncytial colony maximizing surface-to-volume ratio across basalt ridges.
Circumferential radial cluster with central feeding trophocyte and peripheral shields.
Continuous crawling slime hull exhibiting directional treadmilling & apoptosis halos.

geodynamicPerturbationImpact.tickerFeedback: No active perturbations. Seafloor in steady state.
